name: Honda Trail 125 (CT125)
engine: 125 cc air-cooled single, fuel injected, semi-automatic gearbox
intro: Honda's modern trail bike. Some 2021 bikes have a gearshift pedal recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2021 bikes are in recall 21V804 because the gearshift pedal weld can fail.
A-002.reason: A broken shift pedal leaves you stuck in gear. The fix is free.

recalls.what: The gearshift pedal arm weld may fail and the pedal may break off.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the gearshift pedal assembly free.
